# `browser-extension/services/ServerSentEventDecoder.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/ServerSentEventDecoder.js`

Incremental, byte-oriented Server-Sent Events decoder. Provider streams can split both line endings and UTF-8 code points across transport chunks. Keeping undecoded bytes until a complete SSE line exists avoids replacement characters and makes CR, LF, and CRLF equivalent.
